test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Motor Vehicle) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following screwdrivers has cross-shaped tips that are unlikely to slip from the cruciform slots in Philips recessed head screws?
solution:
The correct answer is __Cross-recess screwdriver**(Option 4)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cross-recess screwdriver__ has cross-shaped tips.
 
• It is specifically designed to fit into cruciform slots in Philips recessed head screws.
 
• This type of screwdriver reduces the likelihood of slipping from the slots.
 
• It ensures a secure and efficient grip while tightening or loosening screws.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Offset screwdriver:**
 
 
• It has a handle and blade positioned at an angle to each other.
 
• Used for accessing screws in tight spaces.
 
 
 
• **Stumpy screwdriver:**
 
 
• It is shorter in length compared to standard screwdrivers.
 
• Ideal for tasks in confined areas.
 
 
 
• **Ratchet screwdriver:**
 
 
• Allows for turning screws without repositioning the grip.
 
• Features a ratcheting mechanism for efficiency.
 
 
</ul
